author: 5kO0
content:
Implemented (this session). proto-blue-api's public surface now uses validated proto_blue_syntax newtypes throughout, replacing the bare `String`/`&str` audit smoking-gun (Session.did, Session.handle, LabelerOpts.did, Agent::did(), and the methods that take/return DID/Handle/AT-URI/CID).

Field & accessor changes (proto-blue-api/src/agent.rs):
  Session.did:         String  → Did
  Session.handle:      String  → Handle
  LabelerOpts.did:     String  → Did
  Agent::did():        Option<String> → Option<Did>
  assert_did() (priv): Result<String> → Result<Did>

Method-signature changes:
  login(identifier: &str)        → login(identifier: &AtIdentifier)
  resolve_handle(&str) -> String → resolve_handle(&Handle) -> Did
  follow(subject_did: &str)      → follow(subject_did: &Did)
  like(uri: &str, cid: &str)     → like(uri: &AtUri, cid: &Cid)
  repost(uri: &str, cid: &str)   → repost(uri: &AtUri, cid: &Cid)
  delete_post / delete_like / delete_repost / delete_follow → &AtUri
  get_post_thread(uri: &str)     → get_post_thread(uri: &AtUri)
  get_profile(actor: &str)       → get_profile(actor: &AtIdentifier)
  create_account(handle: &str)   → create_account(handle: &Handle)
  delete_record (priv helper)    → uri: &AtUri (and uses AtUri::rkey() instead of split-rsplit)

Kept as String/&str where no validated newtype semantically fits:
  - access_jwt / refresh_jwt (opaque tokens)
  - email
  - service URL (Agent::new)
  - password
  - text (post body)
  - proxy target (DID-with-fragment, no exact newtype)
  - content_type (MIME)
  - cursor / query params

Internal updates:
  - resume_session: parses the server-returned DID via Did::new, returning AgentError::Other on invalid (was: blindly stored as String).
  - resolve_handle: same — server-returned DID is validated before being returned.
  - upsert_profile: did.clone() (owned String) replaced with did.to_string() since Did::Display matches the wire form.
  - delete_record: uses AtUri::rkey() helper instead of manual rsplit('/').

Test fixes:
  - In-file unit tests (agent.rs):
      session_serde_roundtrip uses Did::new / Handle::new for construction; equality asserts via .as_str().
      All inline mock-server bodies updated `"alice"` → `"alice.test"` so the deserialised Handle passes ensure_valid_handle.
      Login call sites updated to pass &AtIdentifier::new(...).unwrap().
      LabelerOpts construction uses Did::new(...).unwrap() instead of "did:plc:a".into().
      create_account test uses &Handle::new("newuser.test").unwrap().
  - tests/live_pds.rs:
      Imports AtIdentifier, AtUri.
      Login passes &AtIdentifier::new(&creds.handle).expect(...).
      session.did.is_empty() → session.did.as_str().is_empty() (Did has no is_empty).
      delete_post: parses server-returned URI via AtUri::new() before passing.
  - tests/generated_register.rs: was already updated for #3, no further changes.
  - proto-blue-oauth's OAuthSession is unrelated to api::Session; not affected.

Imports added at top of agent.rs:
  use proto_blue_lex_data::Cid;
  use proto_blue_syntax::{AtIdentifier, AtUri, Did, Handle};

Verification (rust-quality §honest reporting):
  cargo build --workspace                                    PASS
  cargo test --workspace                                     PASS (67 suites, 0 failures, 2 ignored — those are the live-PDS tests gated on env vars)
  cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings      PASS
  cargo fmt --all --check                                    PASS

Behavioural change: public-API breaking on proto-blue-api. Wire format unchanged (all newtypes serde-(de)serialize to/from the same string bytes). Migration for downstream consumers:
  let session: Session = ...;
  session.did     // now Did, not String. Use .as_str() for borrow, .to_string() for owned.
  agent.login(&AtIdentifier::new(&handle_str)?, password).await
  agent.follow(&Did::new(&did_str)?, None).await
  agent.like(&AtUri::new(&uri_str)?, &cid_value, None).await
  // etc.

Category: A (root-cause) — replaced the audit's String-everywhere fallback across the entire Agent/Session/LabelerOpts public surface in one bump, plus the methods that naturally consume DID/Handle/AT-URI/CID. Closes #3's downstream beneficiary; the session/agent surface now actually consumes the typed newtypes #3 made the codegen emit.

The audit's primary value at the API boundary is now realised: callers can't accidentally pass random strings where a Did is expected; the type system encodes the on-the-wire invariant end-to-end.
